t: The Endosymbiotic Developer: Bootstrapping an AI Collaborator
s: This article documents the establishment of a human-AI development partnership using a 'Kung Fu prompt system' to provide a frontier AI (Gemini) with deep project context, enabling collaborative software development.
sub: Radical Transparency: Building observable, AI-inspectable systems.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): AI interaction beyond passive analysis.
Kung Fu prompt system: Packaging extensive codebase and philosophy for AI.
Endosymbiotic AI collaboration: AI as a complementary development partner.
